#!/bin/sh
# Nightly log backup. Bundles logs/ into a tarball and copies it to the destination.
set -eu

DEST="backup-srv:/srv/nightly"
STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d)
BUNDLE="logs-$STAMP.tar.gz"

# Refuse to create the tarball inside the very directory it bundles.
case "$PWD" in
  logs) echo "error: refusing to run from inside logs/" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac

if [ ! -d logs ]; then
  echo "error: logs/ not found in $PWD" >&2
  exit 1
fi

# Remove a stale tarball from an earlier run today so tar does not
# complain about a file that is changing as it is read.
rm -f "$BUNDLE"

tar -czf "$BUNDLE" logs/

# Copy the tarball to the backup destination.
scp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST/"

echo "wrote $BUNDLE and copied it to $DEST/"

arguments.command: chmod +x backup.sh && sh -n backup.sh && echo "syntax ok" && mkdir -p logs && echo "sample log line" > logs/app.log && ./backup.sh; echo "exit=$?"
